1: Allah din ke aagaz ki qasam khata hai.
2: Aur woh raat ki qasam khata hai jab woh tareek ho jaati hai aur log us mein harakat chhor dete hain.
3: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ke Rubb ne aap ko na chhora hai, aur na woh aap se nafrat karne laga hai, jaisa mushrikeen ne dawa kiya jab wahi ka silsila kuch arse ke liye ruk gaya.
4: Beshak aakhirat ka ghar aap ke liye duniya ke ghar se behtar hai, un hamesha rehne wali niyamaton ki wajah se jo us mein hain.
5: Bahut jald woh aap ko bharpoor ajr dega, aur aap ki ummat ko bhi, yahan tak ke aap us par raazi ho jayenge jo us ne aap ko aur aap ki ummat ko diya.
6: Beshak us ne aap ko us waqt paya jab aap aise bachche thay jis ke waalid chal base thay. Pas us ne aap ke liye panaah ki jagah banai: pehle aap ke daada Abdul Muttalib ke dil mein aap ki mohabbat daali, aur phir aap ke chacha Abu Talib ke dil mein.
7: Us ne aap ko us haal mein paya ke aap nahin jaante thay ke wahi kya hai aur iman kya hai. Pas us ne aap ko woh sikhaya jo aap nahin jaante thay.
8: Aur us ne aap ko muhtaj paya, pas us ne aap ko be-niyaz kar diya.
9: Is liye us bachche ke saath bura sulook na kijiye jis ka baap bachpan mein chal basa, aur na usey haqeer jaaniye.
10: Aur muhtaj maangne wale ko na jhirkiye.
11: Aur apne oopar Allah ki niyamaton ka shukr ada kijiye aur un ka zikr kijiye.
